item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be windy over the region. Meanwhile, the area of low pressure now over the central part of the South China Sea will move towards the vicinity of Hainan Island and may develop gradually. The associated rainbands will affect the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of this week. The weather will improve gradually over the coast of southern China in the following few days. It will be cooler in the morning and at night.
